name: Remarriage After Divorce
overview: Scripture affirms the sacredness and permanence of marriage as a divine union where a man and woman become one flesh, established from creation (Genesis 2:24; Mark 10:6) and reaffirmed by Christ (Matthew 19:6). Divorce is permitted only on the grounds of fornication, emphasizing that remarriage after divorce generally constitutes adultery (Matthew 5:31-32; 19:9). These passages underscore God's original design for marriage as an unbreakable covenant, warning against casual dissolution and remarriage outside the exception He allows.
